items.title: AI is speeding up recruitment — and putting agency fees under pressure
items.summary: Recruiters say AI is speeding up screening and reshaping agency work, raising questions about whether percentage-based placement fees can hold.
items.titleZh: 人工智能正在加快招聘速度，并给代理费带来压力
items.summaryZh: 招聘人员表示，人工智能正在加速筛选和重塑机构工作，这引发了人们对基于百分比的安置费能否维持的质疑。
